changelog: fix: every DADA2 run was being reported as FAILED after finishing successfully. main.py line 1237 read `_is_dada2_marker`, a name that is referenced exactly once in the codebase and defined nowhere. It sits in the condition of the post-run step that builds the chart tables — after the pipeline has already succeeded and written its results — and a NameError in an if-condition is not caught by the try blocks inside that step, so it reached the outer handler, which marks the job error. The symptom is a log that reads 'dada2_pipeline.R completed successfully', an output folder full of results, and 21 minutes of work shown as a failure. Two changes. The flag is now set where the pipeline script is actually CHOSEN (_ran_dada2, False by default, True in the DADA2 branch) rather than re-derived later from the marker: a second copy of that decision is a second copy that can drift from the first, and the step that needed it had no copy at all. And the post-run extras — PICRUSt2 and the chart tables — are now wrapped so that nothing in them can reach the handler that decides the job's outcome. Whether the chart tables got built has no bearing on whether the analysis ran. A failure there is recorded on the job as post_warnings and written to pipeline.log; the run keeps whatever status the PIPELINE earned it. The beta console shows post_warnings as 'a step after the pipeline did not finish', quoting what failed and saying the analysis itself completed and its results are on disk. It also offers results on a failed job now: a run can write complete results and still be labelled error — this bug did exactly that — and hiding finished work behind a label helps nobody. Jobs already marked failed by this bug have their results intact on disk; open them with View any results, or re-run to get a correctly labelled job.
